title: Hemorrhoid banding
what: The doctor places a tiny rubber band around the base of an internal hemorrhoid. It dries up and falls off in about 1 to 2 weeks.
why: For internal hemorrhoids that bleed or prolapse when ointments do not help.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 20 minutes; you go home right away
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to do

prepare.title: Bowels
prepare.text: An enema or mini-enema is usually done before the procedure. The clinic will tell you how and when.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: A light breakfast is usually fine. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: At home
prepare.text: Have foods ready for soft stools: vegetables, fruit, yogurt drinks, and water.

steps: You lie on your side or in a special chair
The doctor inserts a small instrument into the anus to look
A special device draws the hemorrhoid in
A band is placed around its base
Usually 1 to 3 hemorrhoids are treated at once
The instrument is removed, and the procedure is done
feel: Pressure and fullness during the procedure
For a few days, a heavy feeling and dull ache
An urge to go to the toilet, even though your bowel is empty
after: Keep stools soft: more water and fiber, and do not strain
After 1 to 2 weeks, the hemorrhoid falls off. There may be a little blood
Sometimes a repeat session is needed after a few weeks
red_flags: A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or severe, growing pain

faq.a: The inside of a hemorrhoid has almost no pain nerves. Usually you feel pressure and a dull ache for a few days.

faq.q: Can I go back to work right away?
faq.a: Usually yes, the next day. Avoid heavy lifting for a few days.

reminders.text: Hemorrhoid banding tomorrow. Do the enema as the clinic told you. Bring a pad.
